subject: Latech POC — telemetry & evaluation sprint plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Reed <sophie@latech.ai>, ops@latech.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Latech discovery recap — proposed POC telemetry plan

Hi Sophie — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed plan for the POC telemetry sprint so your team can evaluate Redwood's inference economics and reliability under a production-like workload.

Scope we heard from you:
- 3 models: two smaller retrieval-augmented generators + one bi-encoder for embeddings
- 100–300 qps burst, 40 qps steady-state for peak testing
- Sensitive logs for compliance (redaction + retention rules)
- Success criteria: token latency p95 <= 250ms, pipeline cost per 1M tokens < $X (TBD), zero data exfil on logs

Proposed POC telemetry workplan (2-week sprint):
1) Week 1 — Instrumentation & baseline
   - Export request/response logs to S3 (structured JSON) + masked fields
   - Enable tracing (X-Request-ID propagated) and an end-to-end span for request -> model
   - Baseline dashboards: latency distribution, token throughput, model utilization
2) Week 2 — Evaluation & stress tests
   - Run 4 controlled load tests (5/15/40/100 qps) and capture KV cache hit rates
   - Run synthetic failure scenarios (GPU OOM, model fallback) and observe fallback latency/success
   - Produce evaluation report with charts and recommended config changes

Owners (proposed):
- Instrumentation & tracing: Connor O'Brien (redwood infra)
- Dashboards & queries: Marissa Cole (obs lead)
- Customer outreach + acceptance criteria: Vanessa Ortiz (AE)

Attachments: latech-poc-outline.pdf (POC timeline + telemetry checklist). Link to shared sprint doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_sprint-plan

Next steps I recommend:
- Sophie: confirm the 2-week window starting Mar 9 or propose alternate dates
- Liam / ops: confirm where logs can be delivered (S3 bucket ARN or Redshift?) and any IP allowlists we need to add
- Connor/Marissa: confirm you can provision the dashboards and a tracing span template by Mar 6

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min touchpoint to lock this down.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: latech-poc-outline.pdf (14 KB)
From: Sophie Reed <sophie@latech.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@latech.ai, Liam O'Connor <liam@latech.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Latech discovery recap — proposed POC telemetry plan

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: Mar 9 start is fine; can we extend to a 3-week window if we need additional stress testing?
- Logs: we prefer S3 delivery with server-side encryption; I'll send the bucket ARN and IAM role next.
- Security questionnaire: attaching the SOC / infra questionnaire our security team needs returned.

One ask on telemetry metrics: can you add per-model token emission breakdown and per-client API key rate/latency? That helps our billing reconciliation.

Also looping in Liam (VP Eng) — Liam, any preferences for data retention windows (we typically keep request logs 90 days, but for POC we can relax to 30 days)?

Appreciate the clear owners — Marissa / Connor, anything on your side that blocks the Mar 9 start?

Best,
Sophie
CTO (interim), Latech.ai
Attachment: latech-security-questionnaire.xlsx (22 KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Reed <sophie@latech.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@latech.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Latech discovery recap — proposed POC telemetry plan

Marissa / Connor — forwarding Sophie's reply. Two immediate asks from their side that affect instrumentation:

1) Per-client API key rate/latency metrics (Latech uses separate keys per downstream service)
2) Per-model token emission breakdown (tokens emitted by generator vs. reranker vs. retrieval)

Connor: can you draft the tracing span template (propagate X-Request-ID, span for tokenizer->model->postprocess) and the log schema (JSON fields: timestamp, request_id, api_key_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_hit boolean, latency_ms, error_code)? We should include a redaction rule for PII fields (email, ssn) and ensure logs are masked before export.

Marissa: can you stand up a lightweight Grafana dashboard with the following panels by Mar 6?
- Token throughput (tokens/sec) by model
- p50/p95/p99 latency (ms) per model and aggregated
- KV cache hit rate and effective tokens saved
- Failure rate and error codes trend
- Per-api-key rate / latency heatmap (sampled)

I'll handle SOW/acceptance language and update the shared sprint doc with the POC success criteria (latency, cost, secure logs). Sophie is ok with up to 3-week window if we need extra stress testing.

If either of you see a blocker (access, infra quotas, or missing logging hooks in the runtime), call it out here and we'll escalate.

Thanks — Vanessa
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latech discovery recap — proposed POC telemetry plan

Ack — I can put together the tracing template and the log schema today. Quick notes and constraints so everyone is aligned:

- Tracing: we'll add a single top-level span ("request_inference") and child spans: tokenize, model_infer (per model), postprocess. We'll emit span tags for api_key_id and model_version. Sampler: 100% for the first 48h of the POC, then 10% for steady capture.
- Logs: we can stream structured logs to S3 via the customer's ARN. We'll apply server-side encryption (SSE-S3) and a pre-export redaction step — fields flagged as user_content (email, phone) will be masked with <REDACTED>. Retention: default 30 days for POC, can be extended.
- Dashboards: I'll scaffold the Grafana dashboard and share a link; Marissa, can you add cost-per-1M-token panel (we'll compute based on model-infer time * GPU unit cost)?

Blockers: need Latech to provide
- S3 ARN + IAM role for write access (Sophie said she'll send)
- A list of dev API keys to seed per-key metrics (ops@latech.ai can provide)

I'll drop the tracing template and JSON log schema into the shared sprint doc by EOD and ping Marissa when the dashboard is reachable.

— Connor
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
